name: Greek Humorous Dataset
description: A dataset for evaluating models' ability to recognize humor in Greek-language visual (and/or multimodal) content such as images/memes or annotated text within images.
reputation: Niche, language-specific dataset for Greek multimodal humor detection with limited adoption outside research on humor and Greek NLP.
notes: Language- and culture-specific (Greek) dataset; potentially small and domain-limited, so models may not generalize cross-culturally; multimodal (image + text) annotation challenges; contamination risk depends on overlap with pretraining corpora.
